==Notes==
*Like Shell Shock, Cracked Armor is applied after [[damage calculation|calculating damage]].
*Provided that the prerequisites for additional [[damage]] of the [[skill]]s are met, [[Lightning Bolt]], [[Lightning Orb]], and [[Mind Shock]] deal the same amount of damage from Air Magic rank 14 to 16.
*Unlike the full description states, this skill will not cause the target to apply Cracked Armor to another target.

==Trivia==
